lines.japanese: 「ひよちゃん、ただでさえ学校と執筆で二足の草鞋だからね。その上さらにアルバイトだもん、なおさら自分の時間が貴重なんだと思うよ」
lines.english: “Hiyo already has her hands full wearing two hats—school and writing. Add a part-time job, and every minute she gets to herself must matter even more.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そっか……すごいっすよね、よく考えたら。日和子さんって二足どころか三足の草鞋なんすね」
lines.english: “Oh, right... When you stop and think about it, that's incredible. Hiyoko isn't wearing two hats—she's wearing three.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、二足でいいんだよ」
lines.english: “No. Two is right.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　え、だっていま学校・執筆・アルバイトって──」
lines.english: “Huh? But you just said school, writing, and her part-time job—”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さあ、たまひよが去年なんでここのバイト辞めたか知ってる？」
lines.english: “Chitose, do you know why Tama-chick quit this job last year?”

lines.japanese: 「さ、さあ、聞いてないですけど……」
lines.english: “N-no. Nobody's told me...”

lines.japanese: 「あいつ、なんかのコンテストに応募して賞を獲ったんだよ。それがデビュー作」
lines.english: “She entered some contest and won a prize. That became her debut novel.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、はい、その話なら」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. I know about that.”

lines.japanese: おととい電話で、米田さんから伺いました。期待のデビュー作『ほほえみインサイド』。書籍化されたあとは重版が繰りかえされ、内外の評判も上々みたいです。
lines.english: Yoneda had told me over the phone two days ago. Her much-heralded debut, *Smile Inside*, had gone through printing after printing and won glowing reviews all around.

lines.japanese: 「そしたら、出版社から二作目の依頼が来んじゃん」
lines.english: “So naturally, the publisher came asking for a second book.”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、なるほど。そんで三足の草鞋は無理だから、一足脱いだわけっすね」
lines.english: “Right, right, I see. Three hats were too many, so she took one off.”

lines.japanese: 「すごいよねー、ひよちゃん。あの歳でもう夢を実現させちゃったんだもん」
lines.english: “It's amazing, isn't it? Hiyo made her dream come true at her age.”

lines.japanese: 「でも二作目コケた。仕事来なくなった。はい、昔のバイトに出戻った──ね、二足に戻ってるでしょ」
lines.english: “Then the second book bombed. The work dried up. So back she came to her old job. See? Two hats again.”

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃあん……」
lines.english: “Erii...”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、そういえば」
lines.english: “Um, that reminds me...”

lines.japanese: 俺は米田さんの話を思いだしながら尋ねてみました。
lines.english: Remembering what Yoneda had told me, I put a question to them.

lines.japanese: 「おふたりは、日和子さんの本って読まれたんですか？」
lines.english: “Have either of you read Hiyoko's books?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　うん、読んだよ。なんて言ったっけ、一冊目の方」
lines.english: “Hm? Sure. What was the first one called again?”

lines.japanese: 「『ほほえみインサイド』？」
lines.english: “*Smile Inside*?”

lines.japanese: あ、いま声に出して気付いた。フリッキー５のヒット曲『ほほえみジェノサイド』に似てる。まあ、どうでもいいか。
lines.english: Oh. Saying it aloud, I finally heard it: it sounded a lot like the Fricky Five hit *Smiling Genocide*. Well, never mind.

lines.japanese: 「うん、それそれ。それは面白かったよ」
lines.english: “Yes, that's it. That one was good.”

lines.japanese: 「それは、ですか」
lines.english: “That one?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、二冊目の方は……あはは、私にはちょっと難しかったかな」
lines.english: “Mmm, the second one was... ahaha. Maybe it was a little over my head.”

lines.japanese: 「だから紀奈子さん。アレは難しいとかじゃなくて、フツーにつまんないの」
lines.english: “Kinako, come on. It wasn't difficult. It was just boring.”

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃあん……」
lines.english: “Erii...”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　じゃあ英里子さんはそちらの方を読まれて？」
lines.english: “Hm? So you read the second one too, Eriko?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……んー、まーね」
lines.english: “Yeah... Mm. I guess.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君、千歳君、えりちゃん二冊とも発売日に買ってるんだよ」
lines.english: “Chitose, Chitose—Erii bought both of them the day they came out.”

lines.japanese: 「は、マジすか。まるで熱心なファンみたいじゃないですか」
lines.english: “S-seriously? You sound like a devoted fan.”

lines.japanese: 「ファンかどうかは分からないけど、えりちゃん昔は、けっこうひよちゃんのこと可愛がってたんだよ」
lines.english: “I don't know if she was a fan, but Erii used to dote on Hiyo.”

lines.japanese: 「……うるさいなあ」
lines.english: “...Oh, shut up.”

lines.japanese: と睨みつつも、否定はしないのか……ふーん、本当なんだ……。
lines.english: She glared, but didn't deny it... Huh. So it was true...

lines.japanese: 「で、読後の所感は？」
lines.english: “So what did you think?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、一作目のは良かったんじゃない？　私もローティーンの頃はあーゆー甘酸っぱいの好きだったし」
lines.english: “Oh, the first one was good. I used to like that kind of bittersweet romance myself when I was in my early teens.”

lines.japanese: 「でも二作目のは全然だね。作風変えたいのは分かったけど、力みすぎて筆が上滑りしてる感じ。作風を見せてるだけで作品を書いてない」
lines.english: “The second one was no good, though. I could tell she wanted to change her style, but she tried so hard the prose lost its grip. She was showing off a style instead of writing a book.”

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃん、素人のくせに偉そぉー」
lines.english: “Listen to Erii, talking like an expert when she's a complete amateur.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁーにが。素人に売ってんだから、素人に評価されなきゃ意味ないでしょー」
lines.english: “Oh, please. She's selling it to ordinary readers. If ordinary readers don't think it's any good, what's the point?”

lines.japanese: ……ふむ。
lines.english: ...Hmm.

lines.japanese: まあ、なんていうか……なんにせよ、まだ読んでない俺には、口を挟む権利ないか。
lines.english: Well, however you looked at it... I hadn't read either book yet, so I had no right to join the debate.

lines.japanese: 「てゆか、千歳だって読んだんだろ？　おまえ、たまひよのファンとか言ってたじゃん」
lines.english: “Wait, you've read them too, haven't you, Chitose? You said you were a Tama-chick fan.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ええ、まあ……」
lines.english: “Ah. Yes, well...”

lines.japanese: くそう、いちいち細かいことを覚えてるひとだな。
lines.english: Damn it. She remembered every last little detail.

lines.japanese: 「まっ、ひとりでもそういうやつがいて、あいつも少しは報われたんじゃねーの？」
lines.english: “Still, I guess having even one fan like you means at least some of her effort was rewarded.”
“Ha... haha...”

lines.japanese: 報われて……ないだろうなあ。どう考えても。
lines.english: Rewarded... no. Not by me. Not by any sane reckoning.

lines.japanese: 「うん、良かった良かった。千歳君、これからもずっと応援してあげてね」
lines.english: “Yes, isn't that nice? Chitose, make sure you keep supporting her.”

lines.japanese: 「も、もちろんですよ」
lines.english: “O-of course I will.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、細川玉木に“これから”ってあんの？　あったらレストランのバイトなんかしてなくない？」
lines.english: “But does Tamaki Hosokawa even have a future? If she did, would she be waiting tables?”

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃん違うよう。ひよちゃんは私の代わりに戻ってきてくれたんだよ、店長に泣きつかれて仕方なかったんだよ」
lines.english: “That's not why she came back, Erii. Hiyo came back to take my place. The Manager begged her until she couldn't say no.”

lines.japanese: 「それはきっかけに過ぎないでしょ。渡りに舟ってゆーか、最後のひと押しってゆーか？」
lines.english: “That only gave her an opening. The excuse she'd been waiting for, or the final push—something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ひょっとして店長も、分かっててあのタイミングで電話したんじゃない？　あのひと馬鹿オヤジの皮かぶってっけど、本当はエグいぐらいアタマ回るでしょ」
lines.english: “Oh, maybe the Manager knew exactly what he was doing when he called her. He acts like some dumb old man, but underneath he’s scary smart, right?”

lines.japanese: はは、さすが英里子さん、自分と同じタイプの人間のことはよく分かるようで。
lines.english: Ha. As expected of Eriko: she recognized her own kind.

lines.japanese: 「もー。そーゆー風に、えりちゃんにイジワルなこと言われるの分かってて、それでもひよちゃんは戻ってきてくれたんだよ？」
lines.english: “Honestly. Hiyo knew perfectly well you'd say mean things like that, Erii, and she still came back for us.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そっすよね。べつにアルバイトするだけなら、わざわざ一度辞めたとこ選ばなくてもいいわけだし」
lines.english: “Oh, that's true. If she only needed a part-time job, she didn't have to come back to the same place she'd already quit.”

lines.japanese: 「そ。ひよちゃんはそれだけこのお店が好きだったんだよ。だめだよえりちゃん、優しく迎えてあげなきゃ」
lines.english: “Exactly. That's how much Hiyo loved this restaurant. You have to give her a warm welcome, Erii.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、チョー心外ー。優しくなかったら私、あんなやつ軽くシカトしてんですけどー」
lines.english: “Wow, I am deeply offended. If I weren't being nice, I'd just ignore her.”

lines.japanese: 「イジワルするだけましってこと？」
lines.english: “So picking on her is the kinder option?”

lines.japanese: 「ちーがうって、だから意地悪とかじゃなくてー」
lines.english: “That's not what I mean. I keep telling you, it isn't picking on—”
“Ah!”

lines.japanese: とつぜん紀奈子さんが、英里子さんの眉間に指を突きつけて叫びました。
lines.english: Without warning, Kinako thrust a finger between Eriko's eyes and cried out.
“W-what...?”

lines.japanese: 「きのうの宿題！　見つけた、えりちゃんの欠点！」
lines.english: “Yesterday's homework! I found it—I found your flaw, Erii!”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 勇ましい表情の紀奈子さんと、ぽかんと口を開ける英里子さん。
lines.english: Kinako looked ready for battle; Eriko merely gaped.

lines.japanese: 「ああ……え、なんすか？」
lines.english: “Oh... Uh, what is it?”

lines.japanese: すっ、と紀奈子さんの人差し指が頭上に掲げられ──
lines.english: Kinako's index finger swept grandly overhead—

lines.japanese: 「えりちゃんは」
lines.english: “Erii, your—”

lines.japanese: ──びしっ、とふたたび英里子さんの目の前に戻ってきました。
lines.english: —then snapped back down before Eriko's eyes.

lines.japanese: 「付け睫毛、がんばり過ぎ！」
lines.english: “You're trying too hard with those false eyelashes!”

lines.japanese: 「え……お、おかしい？」
lines.english: “Are... are they weird?”

lines.japanese: 「びみょーに不自然！」
lines.english: “Just unnatural enough to notice!”

lines.japanese: 「……まじで」
lines.english: “...Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょいまじ！」
lines.english: “Kind of serious!”

lines.japanese: 「あー、英里子さん沈んじゃった」
lines.english: “Ah. Eriko wilted.”

lines.japanese: 「ひよちゃんの仇！」
lines.english: “Hiyo is avenged!”

lines.japanese: ふん、と両腕に力こぶを作るポーズの紀奈子さん。
lines.english: Kinako snorted and struck a pose, flexing both arms.

lines.japanese: 「ようし、あとでひよちゃんにも教えてあげねば」
lines.english: “All right. I'll have to tell Hiyo later.”

lines.japanese: 「……紀奈子さん、意地悪ってのはそーゆーのを言うんだよ」
lines.english: “...Kinako, that right there is what picking on someone looks like.”
